title: BAE Exchange
description: baexchange.mu ALL DATA BAE Exchange is a fintech platform based in Port Louis, Mauritius, providing cryptocurrency exchange and international money transfers through 400 plus physical agents across the island and a digital platform serving 32,000 plus clients. Founded by Flavia Moktof and Gungo Boucher, it operates across 7 countries including Mauritius, Seychelles, Maldives, Kenya, Tanzania, Madagascar and Reunion. Its hybrid online and offline model connects digital crypto trading with traditional remittance services targeting the Mauritian diaspora in France and India. Key services include BTC, ETH and USDT exchange for Mauritian rupees, competitive international transfer rates and insurance offerings. The company also runs financial education programs including webinars on cryptocurrency and regulatory frameworks in Mauritius. It positions itself as a trusted partner for underserved communities needing access to both modern crypto and traditional financial services.
